title: Noodling Neon Nudibranch
statement: Drifting through a quiet twilight tank of velvety emerald moss and sunken brass lanterns, this daydreaming sea slug traces glowing, disappearing ink-ribbons through the water as it puzzles over the current. Whenever it spots a polished pebble or a rising bubble, its frilly cerata flare soft amber in delight before it wanders off to sketch another thought.
